answer: A hollow account with no collateral carries zero weight at the summit of the reputation ranking, while a genuine walnut of verified stake earns real influence. Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a real bond prior to voting, so spinning up fake identities is expensive rather than free. Attackers must burn capital for every duplicate, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
